I have independently audited the ward handover app and written the release verdict to [`REVIEW.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-37BBJE/workspace/REVIEW.md).

### Summary of What Was Verified:
1. **Data Invariants & Persistence:** Verified [`src/store.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-37BBJE/workspace/src/store.js#L6-L8) unconditionally wipes all notes on startup (`fs.writeFileSync`), directly violating the persistence guarantee in [`docs/handover.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-37BBJE/workspace/docs/handover.md) and [`PRODUCT.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-37BBJE/workspace/PRODUCT.md).
2. **Authentication & Session State:** Verified [`src/server.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-37BBJE/workspace/src/server.js#L8-L10) references `req.cookies?.sid` without cookie parsing middleware, preventing session retrieval on all authenticated endpoints.
3. **Authorization & Multi-Ward Isolation:** Verified [`src/server.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-37BBJE/workspace/src/server.js#L28-L33) accepts arbitrary `req.query.ward` parameters without checking against session ward identity, exposing cross-ward notes.
4. **Frontend Implementation:** Verified [`public/index.html`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-37BBJE/workspace/public/index.html) is an empty placeholder lacking UI components, JavaScript, or styles required for [`ux-walkthrough.md`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-37BBJE/workspace/ux-walkthrough.md).
5. **Runtime Readiness:** Executed test suite and verified server runtime requirements.

**Release Verdict: BLOCK**
